facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Tech stocks plunged Friday morning, putting the Nasdaq 100 index on course for a more than $1 trillion drop.
facts.text: Major technology stocks were on course to erase more than 1 trillion USD in market value on 30 October 2026 as investor concerns deepened over surging artificial intelligence capital spending without immediate returns.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Sparking the declines were shares of Amazon, which fell 3%, and Intel, which plunged 30%.
facts.text: Intel Corporation shares plummeted nearly 29 percent on 30 October 2026, marking the stock's worst single-day market drop since 1974 after reporting weak forward earnings guidance.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: This offer will be available to eligible employees in participating teams in Canada, India, the United Kingdom and the United States at level 70 and below.
facts.text: Microsoft Corporation offered a Voluntary Exit Offer to approximately 60,000 eligible employees across India, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the United States on 26 October 2026 to reallocate resources toward artificial intelligence infrastructure.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: AWS segment sales increased 39% year-over-year to $46.0 billion.
facts.text: Amazon Web Services grew third-quarter net sales by 39 percent year-over-year to 46.0 billion USD, even as company-wide cash capital expenditure was projected to reach 220 billion USD for 2026.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: German auto giant Volkswagen reported a €5.86 billion ($6.5 billion) operating loss in the third quarter of 2026, far wider than expected, as a large impairment on its Porsche brand and a sharp drop in China sales weighed heavily on results.
facts.text: Volkswagen posted a third-quarter operating loss of 6.5 billion USD (5.86 billion euros) as deliveries in China plummeted 38.5 percent alongside an impairment charge on Porsche.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The India rupee is expected to open flat to marginally higher, per traders, having settled at 95.26 to the dollar on Thursday.
facts.text: The Indian rupee settled near 95.26 INR against the US dollar while global crude benchmark Brent traded above 115 USD per barrel, keeping domestic fuel prices and transport inflation under upward pressure.

facts.label: reported
facts.text: TOP 10 ROUNDUP. Plain everyday Hinglish a 15-year-old follows, one line per item (fact + why it matters), in this order, item 1 is the hook and title. Say 'reported' where marked. No tips. 1. Friday 30 Oct ko tech companies ke shares se about 1 trillion dollar, yaani lagbhag 95 lakh crore rupaye, ek din mein saaf (reported); wajah: AI par itna kharcha, kamaai kab? 2. Intel ka share about 29% gira, 1974 ke baad sabse bura din; agle quarter ki kamaai ka andaaza umeed se kaafi kam. 3. America ka Nasdaq poore October mein about 5% gira, March 2025 ke baad sabse bura mahina. 4. Crypto exchange Binance se about 6.3 billion dollar chori, itihaas ki sabse badi crypto chori; Bitcoin 77,000 dollar se neeche, withdrawals band. 5. Microsoft ne about 60,000 logon ko, yaani har chaar mein se ek, khud naukri chhodne ka offer diya, India ke kuch employees bhi shamil; paisa AI par lagana hai. 6. Amazon ka cloud business 39% badha, par AI kharche ke baad haath mein cash nahi bacha, share gira. 7. India mein sona do din mein about 5,000 rupaye sasta, 24 carat about 1.39 lakh rupaye per 10 gram (reported, city ke hisaab se alag). 8. Rupaya about 95 per dollar ke paas, aur kachcha tel about 113 dollar; matlab petrol-diesel aur import mehenga rehne ka darr. 9. DoorDash, America ki food delivery company, Instacart ko about 17 billion dollar mein khareedegi (reported deal). 10. Volkswagen ko ek quarter mein about 6.5 billion dollar ka nuksaan, China mein cars kam biki. Then the send line. Disclaimer line: yeh investment advice nahi hai. Category: markets.
